title: A 5,000-Foot Wall of Dust Swallowed Phoenix in Seconds

scenes.text: A wall of dust 5,000 feet tall swallowed a major US city.
On July 5, 2011, it rolled into Phoenix, Arizona.
The wall stretched almost 100 miles wide.
Storm winds slammed down and spread out, scooping up dry desert dust.
Visibility dropped to almost nothing within seconds.
They call it a haboob. Five thousand feet of desert, moving as one.

description:
On July 5, 2011, a wall of dust over 5,000 feet tall and almost 100 miles wide rolled into Phoenix.
It was pushed by thunderstorm winds over dry desert ground.
Have you ever seen a dust storm?
first_comment: A haboob is a wall of dust, not a storm of rain. Have you ever seen one in person?
